newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa says fuel major cost in Jan-June.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa says fuel major cost in Jan-June.

text.p: Lufthansa said fuel costs were a major cost factor representing eight percent of total operational spending in the first half of 1996 .
The German carrier secured most of its 1996 fuel needs before prices hit their October peak thus limiting their impact on costs, it stated in its latest monthly investor relations report.
The group continued a three-month recovery with a seat load factor of 76.9 percent in September for a 0.6 percent points year-on-year rise, Lufthansa said.
The September load factor followed a 1.0 percent point rise in August and a fractional rise in July after falls in May and June. This kept the average load factor stable for the third quarter.

The strongest passenger growth in September was shown by regional subsidiary Lufthansa CityLine GmbH which carried 305,000 passengers, a rise of 21.9 percent, and by holiday carrier Condor Flugdienst GmbH whose passenger numbers grew 8.4 percent to 759,000.

Parent company Deutsche Lufthansa AG flew 2.99 million passengers in September, a rise of 1.6 percent, and recorded a seat load factor of 75.5 percent, up 0.3 percent points on the same month last year.

Lufthansa AG's January-September passenger numbers were 0.8 percent down at 23.9 million and the seat load factor over the first three quarters was down 1.8 percent points at 68.7 percent. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
